name: scriba
//scribaPins: scribaPins records the Angular, NestJS and Zod majors and the TypeScript line. PLT-01 installs none of the three packages; PLT-02, PLT-03 and PLT-04 install them at these majors. If the newest Angular major's build tooling excludes the TypeScript line, implementation stops and records the conflict for the Navigator. Neither pin is changed silently.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bbartolome/scriba-contracts && npm run build -w @bbartolome/scriba-api -w @bbartolome/scriba-web -w @bbartolome/scriba-packs -w @bbartolome/scriba-e2e
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bbartolome/scriba-contracts && npm run build -w @bbartolome/scriba-api && concurrently -n contracts,api-tsc,api,web "tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "SCRIBA_BOOKS_DIR='$PWD/.scriba-dev' SCRIBA_PACKS_DIR='$PWD/packages/packs' SCRIBA_EXAMPLES_DIR='$PWD/examples' SCRIBA_DEV_ORIGINS=http://localhost:4200 SCRIBA_DEV_AUTH=1 SCRIBA_SETUP_URL_BASE=http://localhost:4200 node --watch apps/api/dist/main.js" "npm run start -w @bbartolome/scriba-web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces && npm run lint:examples && npm run lint:packs && prettier --check .
scripts.lint:examples: npm run build -w @bbartolome/scriba-contracts && npm run build -w @bbartolome/scriba-api && node scripts/examples-check/index.mjs
scripts.lint:packs: npm run build -w @bbartolome/scriba-contracts && npm run build -w @bbartolome/scriba-api && node scripts/lint-packs.mjs
scripts.eval:agent: npm run build -w @bbartolome/scriba-contracts && npm run build -w @bbartolome/scriba-api && node scripts/eval-agent/run.mjs
